podcast.title: Distribution Deals with Major Labels
podcast.body: Indie labels often have distribution deals with major labels, allowing wider reach for their artists. "In many cases, these acts came from the world of indie labels who had distribution deals with the major labels."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 2: The Role of Indie Rock

podcast.title: Interest in Active Rock Radio
podcast.body: Many independent labels recognized active rock radio outlets as a viable third option for promoting new music, alongside alternative stations and mainstream rock outlets. "Many of them were of the independent variety. They saw active rock outlets as a viable third option to promote new music behind alternative stations and mainstream rock outlets."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 2: The Role of Indie Rock

podcast.title: UK Chart Success (2010s)
podcast.body: In the UK, acts from indie labels achieved great chart success in the alt-rock, heavy metal, and hard rock genres during the 2010s. "Once again, acts from indie labels did great."
